208: const DEFAULT_REPLANNER_MAX_CONCURRENT: usize = 8;

210: /// Bounded notification replanner that drains a channel with limited concurrency.
211: #[derive(Clone)]
212: pub struct NotificationReplanner {
213:     sender: tokio::sync::mpsc::Sender<i64>,
214: }
215: 
216: impl NotificationReplanner {
217:     /// Create a new replanner with a bounded channel and spawn the worker loop.
218:     pub fn new(on_notify: Arc<dyn Fn(i64) + Send + Sync>) -> Self {
219:         let (sender, receiver) = tokio::sync::mpsc::channel(DEFAULT_REPLANNER_CHANNEL_CAPACITY);
220:         let semaphore = Arc::new(tokio::sync::Semaphore::new(
221:             DEFAULT_REPLANNER_MAX_CONCURRENT,
222:         ));
223:         let semaphore_clone = semaphore.clone();
224:         tokio::spawn(async move {
225:             let mut rx = receiver;
226:             while let Some(event_id) = rx.recv().await {
227:                 let semaphore = semaphore_clone.clone();
228:                 let on_notify = on_notify.clone();
229:                 tokio::spawn(async move {
230:                     let _permit = semaphore.acquire().await.unwrap();
231:                     (on_notify)(event_id);
232:                 });
233:             }
234:         });
235:         Self { sender }
236:     }
237: 
238:     pub async fn send(&self, event_id: i64) {
239:         let _ = self.sender.send(event_id).await;
240:     }
241: 
242:     /// Create a no-op replanner that discards all notifications.
243:     pub fn noop() -> Self {
244:         let (sender, _receiver) = tokio::sync::mpsc::channel(DEFAULT_REPLANNER_CHANNEL_CAPACITY);
245:         drop(_receiver);
246:         Self { sender }
247:     }
248: }

574: /// Return the `.ics` resource name listed in a calendar PROPFIND response.
575: fn extract_resource_name(body: &str) -> Option<String> {
576:     for line in body.lines() {
577:         if line.contains("<D:href>") && line.contains(".ics") {
578:             let start = line.find("<D:href>")? + "<D:href>".len();
579:             let href = line[start..].trim_end().strip_suffix("</D:href>")?;
580:             let name = href.rsplit('/').next()?.strip_suffix(".ics")?;
581:             return Some(name.to_owned());
582:         }
583:     }
584:     None
585: }
